notes: Fiscal year ended October 3, 2026, a 53-week year (the 10-K: 'Fiscal 2026 results include the benefit from a fifty-third week of operations'); data.js fy reads 'Sep 2026'. This edition skips fiscal 2025. Filings: FY2026 Form 10-K (accession 0001744489-26-000066, filed November 17, 2026) and the 2026 proxy statement filed January 22, 2026 (accession 0001744489-26-000013), the latest proxy, both read on www.sec.gov. WALT DISNEY is deceased. The proxy's stock ownership section lists only Vanguard and BlackRock as 5% holders and no Disney family member, trust or foundation, so family is null. HOLDER DATES: the proxy cites each firm's Schedule 13G/A without giving its date or as-of date, so asOf is null; the share counts are unchanged from the 2025 proxy, so the filings are probably stale. BUYBACKS tripled to $9.0 billion (from $3.5 billion in fiscal 2025); dividends were $2.6 billion. STOCK COMP is net of $199 million capitalized. GEOGRAPHY: the Total column of the revenue note (Americas, of which over 90% is the United States; Europe; Asia Pacific), summing to total revenues of $102,344 million. Robert Iger was CEO until Joshua D'Amaro was appointed effective March 18, 2026 (10-K executive officers list).
